source_authentication_contract.identity_authority: data/survival/items/world_source_bindings.v3.json (five A1 bindings); a source id that is not a pinned binding is rejected as UNKNOWN_SOURCE_BINDING
anti_spoof: A caller-supplied owner string (for example "A1") is not authentication and fails the shape check.
The receipt must be field-for-field equal to the injected host's current answer, so a caller-built dictionary fails.
The hero cell must be an A1-authored stand cell for that binding.
The binding document SHA is persisted with the custody record; re-pinning A1 data invalidates stale custody.
If canonical world_action already settled the same poi/action, A3 refuses the claim (SOURCE_SETTLED_BY_CANONICAL_WORLD_ACTION).
source_authentication_contract.quarry: CLOSED. The pinned A8 document status is REJECTED_PENDING_EVIDENCE_FAIL_CLOSED and no Quarry binding exists; A3 never fabricates A8 rewards, POI arrival or Core ownership.

canonical_authority.queue: survival_economy.jobs via economy_service.gd (enqueue/advance/collect/cancel). No A3 queue exists.
canonical_authority.job_identity: canonical state.counter -> job_%06d, stable across reloads
canonical_authority.knowledge: survival.knowledge.recipes via research_recipe(blueprint|specimen|targeted). No A3 learned-recipe map exists.
canonical_authority.clock: A0 soh.economy.active_tick.v1 receipt; there is no A3 set_time_source and no wall-clock queue maturity.
canonical_authority.offline: V6 offline_operation_planner armed custody + A0 D055/D060 projection; A3 adds no offline planner.

consumer_contracts.A6: get_projections() is read-only; UI flags never authorise a claim or a grant.
consumer_contracts.A7: R13 native gate + V5-V7 adapter regression must pass on the exact composed SHA before any balance or acceptance statement.
consumer_contracts.A8: Provide a durable site instance, native two-route collision/reload proof and a new APPROVED authorization SHA before any Quarry source, cost or reward is enabled.

known_limits: A3 cannot prove A0 composition, browser/Web playtest, human pacing or final balance.
The source host is a composition-root callable; A0 must not expose it to UI input.
Route costs are catalog-derived readings, not a human-tuned balance verdict.
